reason: I don't trust an AI with my money, cute pet or not. I already put the same amount into index funds every month for free and barely look at it, so I don't see what I'd be paying for.
objection: Handing my savings to an AI agent that buys and pays for things on its own. Limits and an off switch sound nice, but I'd still be paying a monthly fee to worry about what it did, when my plain auto-invest works fine.
would_change_my_mind: Years of real-money results from other regular people, with the money held at a licensed broker I already know, and a price that costs less than a cheap streaming subscription.
